title: Duplicate claim submission detected — claims-api
summary: Payer clearinghouse rejected claim CLM-2381 as a duplicate. Submission log shows two outbound POSTs for the same claim ~40s apart after a gateway timeout and automatic retry.
alert_body:
Monitor: claims-submission-duplicate-check
Service: claims-api (prod)
Claim ID: CLM-2381
Patient ID: PT-0417 (synthetic)
Payer: fixture-payer-01
First submission: 2026-09-10T05:11:22Z (timed out after 8000ms)
Retry submission: 2026-09-10T05:12:01Z (succeeded, HTTP 201)
Clearinghouse response: 277CA duplicate-claim flag, ref DUP-88213
On-call: paged EM (Marcus), Revenue Cycle Platform
Runbook: none — first time this alert has fired for this service
notes_for_demo: This is the one fully-wired ticket. Ticketdroid should run RCA + patch + PR against this.

title: Intermittent double-booking on appointment reschedule
summary: Two appointment slots created for the same patient/provider pair when a reschedule request is submitted twice in quick succession (likely a double-click on the patient portal).
alert_body:
Error: SlotConflictWarning (non-fatal)
Service: scheduling-api
Occurrences: 6 in last 24h
First seen: 2026-09-08T14:02:11Z
notes_for_demo: Fixture only — shows the inbox has more than one signal type. Do not build a fix for this one.

title: Nightly claims batch export job ran 40 min longer than baseline
